rules.title: Nameplate and marking legibility
rules.quote: Verify stamped nameplate data matches the work order model and serial.

rules.title: Flange face condition
rules.quote: Examine flange faces for visible damage or indications; report indications for review.

rules.title: Bonnet fastener presence
rules.quote: Confirm bonnet fasteners are present where the bonnet joint is visible.

rules.title: Body casting surface review
rules.quote: Review visible body surfaces and record suspected indications for qualified review.

rules.title: Pressure test record required
rules.quote: Pressure testing requires test records; not evaluated from visual evidence.
